title: Payment channels
summary: Configure Blaaiz collection and existing payout routes.

title: Configure Blaaiz deposit channels and transfer payouts
summary: Choose multiple provider-backed routes, verify readiness, and safely hand an asset from legacy methods to managed channels.
prerequisites: SuperAdmin access; approved provider capability; correct environment; eligible, verified provider wallet; country/asset permissions.

steps.title: Prepare prerequisites
steps.instruction: Use SuperAdmin. Configure the asset and country/asset mapping, enable the intended audience and deposit/withdrawal operation, and discover/register/verify the provider wallet in the current environment. Provider wallets are not House accounts.

steps.title: Create a draft route
steps.instruction: Open Payment channels. Select Deposit or Withdrawal / transfer payout, the asset, country (or All eligible mapped countries), Blaaiz, a compatible provider wallet, and an implemented capability. Route identity cannot be edited later; create a new route and pause the old one.

steps.title: Set presentation and audiences
steps.instruction: Choose the customer-facing name, instructions, display order and eligible audiences. Amount limits apply to fixed-amount collections/payouts. Dedicated bank accounts use no fixed deposit amount and therefore cannot enforce transaction limits in this form. Existing compliance controls still apply.

steps.title: Review readiness
steps.instruction: Confirm provider feature approval only after checking your provider account. Review blocked reasons and warnings. CAD requests use the verified default CAD collection wallet; the Interac endpoint cannot arbitrarily select another pooled CAD wallet. Business card checkout is not implemented. Business virtual accounts are NGN-only.

steps.title: Activate the complete intended set
steps.instruction: Prepare the required countries and audiences before activation. The FIRST activation manages the whole asset/direction in this environment, replacing legacy discovery for that scope. Pausing every channel leaves no methods; it deliberately does not restore legacy methods. Drafts alone do not change existing methods.

steps.title: Test the correct client
steps.instruction: Business: open Business wallets, select a wallet and choose Deposit. Mobile: install the new staging build, open a wallet and Add money. A browser refresh does not update an installed mobile binary. New bank-account deposits do not appear in a transfer-specific fixed-amount checkout; fund the wallet first and then pay from it.

steps.title: Separate payout routing
steps.instruction: Withdrawal configuration governs the existing remittance transfer payout, not a new cash-out-from-any-wallet screen. Country means recipient destination. The configured funding wallet must match the transfer source asset. Routes are ranked by display order; the saved payout keeps its selected route. Current executable payouts are NGN bank transfer and CAD Interac only.

expectedResult: Only ready active channels matching the owner, country, asset and audience appear. A submitted payment or provisioned bank account is not a confirmed wallet credit.
warnings: Blaaiz only. No Flutterwave or other-provider integration is included.
No balances are fabricated, and account creation does not credit funds. Only provider-confirmed, identity/amount/currency-verified receipts may credit the assigned wallet.
Provider api-dev: NGN virtual accounts can receive test deposits; USD creation works but deposits do not settle; GBP/EUR creation is on hold. Do not send real funds to development details.
No new channel fees or currency conversions are introduced. Existing collection fee/ledger policies remain.
Changing credentials does not reassign an old receiving account or payment to another provider connection.
troubleshooting: No channels: check first-activation handover, active/ready state, selected asset, profile country, audience, country mapping and wallet status.
Blocked: read the precise reason. A checkbox is not evidence of provider approval. Correct configuration and use Refresh; never bypass it with database edits.

Bank account pending: Check account status. USD/GBP/EUR require verified individuals and complete currency-specific customer fields. NGN also supports verified businesses. A provider rejection needs customer-data review; a timeout requires lookup, not repeated creation.
Interac outcome unknown: retain the existing collection ID and check its status. Do not create a second charge. A durable pending submission may need operations reconciliation.
Pause stops new discovery/initiation but does not discard valid deposits arriving at previously issued bank accounts. Reconciliation and existing payment ownership remain intact.

title: Deposit into a business wallet
summary: Use backend-configured Interac or eligible dedicated bank details and recover interrupted funding safely.
prerequisites: The selected business needs ViewWallets; ManageFunding and provider-approved KYB are required to initiate or provision.
SuperAdmin must enable a compatible channel and provider wallet.

steps.title: Choose the correct business and wallet
steps.instruction: Open Business wallets and select the intended wallet. The selected business and wallet determine access. ViewWallets is required to read; ManageFunding is additionally required to start a deposit or create receiving details.

steps.title: Choose an available channel
steps.instruction: The Deposit section lists only supported active channels. Select the customer-facing option. Two methods with similar names keep distinct channel IDs. An empty list is not a request to enter your own provider or bank details.

steps.title: Use Interac
steps.instruction: For CAD, enter a positive amount and valid payer email, then send the Interac request once. The browser retains a reference before initiation. Follow the provider instructions and check payment status; an email or redirect is not confirmation of funds.

steps.title: Use NGN bank deposits
steps.instruction: Select an NGN dedicated-bank-account channel and Set up bank account. Complete KYB first. Wait until the account is Active and verified bank details are shown. Send only the indicated currency to those details. Creation starts with no wallet credit.

steps.title: Recover or refresh
steps.instruction: Use Check payment status or Refresh status for an existing attempt/account. If initiation times out, read the saved payment rather than creating another. Refresh the wallet after provider confirmation. Switching business cancels old requests and clears old business details.

expectedResult: Only ready active channels matching the owner, country, asset and audience appear. A submitted payment or provisioned bank account is not a confirmed wallet credit.
warnings: Blaaiz business card checkout and USD/GBP/EUR virtual accounts for type=business are not available in this release. NGN dedicated accounts and CAD Interac are the connected business deposit methods.
Use only ready customer-specific bank details. Treasury/provider pooled accounts and House accounts are not a customer deposit address.
Never send real funds to provider-development details. Do not share passwords, card data, access tokens or API keys with support.
troubleshooting: No methods: ask an administrator to review the active payment channels, business audience, mapping, provider wallet and approval.
Pending bank setup: refresh; do not repeatedly create accounts. A provider rejection may require additional business information or corrected KYB.

A confirmed deposit missing from balance requires the business/wallet currency, collection or bank-account reference, amount, time, and a redacted error. Do not submit a second deposit merely to test a refresh.

title: Enable automatic personal receiving accounts
summary: Prepare provider-backed deposit routes so adding a personal wallet can open its dedicated receiving account.
prerequisites: An existing production-approved provider wallet and bank-account capability for the required currency, profile country and individual audience.
The user must satisfy the existing KorridorX and provider identity requirements; a wallet alone does not grant a bank account.

steps.title: Enable the currency and country mapping
steps.instruction: In Master data, check the supported fiat asset, Individual and Deposit capabilities, profile-country mapping and deposit permission. Review the currency decimal places: the mobile amount form uses this configured value.

steps.title: Prepare the provider route
steps.instruction: In Provider wallets, verify the current-connection collection wallet for the asset. In Payment channels, configure and activate a Deposit channel with the dedicated-bank-account capability and Individuals audience. Confirm provider approval only after it is actually available on the provider account. With multiple eligible provider wallets, set the intended collection default or let the user select a bank-deposit option.

steps.title: Open the user wallet
steps.instruction: Adding a personal wallet automatically requests its receiving account when eligible. Existing wallets request setup when the user opens Add money. Pending results expose Check account status; only provider-confirmed Active details can be used. Opening a wallet or creating receiving details does not create a transfer or credit a balance.

steps.title: Resolve a blocked account
steps.instruction: VerificationRequired means complete identity approval and check again. Unavailable means review the route, country and currency capabilities. An uncertain creation is looked up before another creation is allowed. Existing accounts remain tied to their saved provider connection and route.

expectedResult: Eligible personal wallets show their persistent receiving details without requiring an amount or creating a transfer. Unsupported or pending accounts show a specific status.
warnings: The application cannot enable an unapproved provider capability. Staging deployment with production Blaaiz credentials still uses real provider accounts.
Keep CAD Interac receiving-email and Money Request configuration separate. Business receiving-account setup keeps its existing permissions and supported currencies.
troubleshooting: No payment method: inspect active Payment channels, the individual audience, profile country, country-asset Deposit permission and verified provider wallet. Adding a wallet does not create these admin settings.
A previous-connection receiving account requires operational reconciliation; it must not silently move to a new provider connection.
USD showing zero decimal places is asset configuration; correct Master data deliberately before further amount testing.

title: Check wallet, PIN and funding notifications
summary: Understand automatic device registration, confirmed-credit receipts and branded email delivery.
prerequisites: Notification worker, SMTP delivery and Firebase delivery must be configured in the server environment. This page does not store credentials.
The installed mobile build must have its existing matching Firebase configuration, and the customer must allow notifications on their phone.

steps.title: Register the customer device
steps.instruction: After sign-in, the app requests phone permission once when needed, then registers the device with KorridorX. Notifications shows enabled only after permission and successful registration. A denied permission is respected; the customer can enable it in device settings and return to the app.

steps.title: Review the event
steps.instruction: New personal wallet creation and successful PIN setup/change queue account notices. Verified incoming wallet credits queue the actual amount credited and transaction reference. Existing transfer, support and account-security notification flows remain in place. Viewing a balance or checking account status is not a new funding event.

steps.title: Review delivery
steps.instruction: Open Monitoring, notifications & audit and inspect delivery status, channel and redacted error for the event. SMTP and push use their existing retry worker. A successful wallet credit remains successful even if delivery is temporarily unavailable; resolve delivery configuration without replaying the deposit.

steps.title: Read the branded receipt
steps.instruction: SMTP wraps existing account and transaction content in the shared green-and-pink KorridorX design. PIN values are never included. Security codes and action links retain their existing expiry and redaction policies. Funding receipts show the actual wallet credit, including any existing provider net settlement deduction.

expectedResult: New eligible events are recorded once with their underlying operation and delivered through configured email and registered push channels, with delivery status available for support.
warnings: Phone notification permission cannot be forced by the app. Permission alone does not prove backend registration or Firebase delivery.
Transfer fees, FX markup and provider deposit charges remain separate. This release does not choose a provider-fee absorption policy or modify balances.
troubleshooting: After a database reset, signing in registers the device again; older erased notification history is not recreated.

Check NotificationDelivery WorkerEnabled, Smtp IsEnabled and Firebase IsEnabled plus existing sender/project credentials through the authorized server configuration process. Do not paste secrets into support messages.
Queued email with no delivery: review worker and SMTP state. Push failure with phone permission: review device registration, matching Firebase project, server credentials and delivery status.
